summary: Credit card interest rates exceeding 30% p.a. challenged as unfair trade practice; RBI's exclusive regulatory authority over interest rates; statutory bar under Section 21A and 35A of Banking Regulation Act prohibiting courts from scrutinizing interest rates; Consumer Protection Act claims rejected; NCDRC's jurisdictional overreach corrected; interest rate fixation deemed within RBI's domain; usury claims dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; NCDRC judgment set aside; banks' right to determine interest rates upheld; no regulatory cap on credit card interest imposed.
